description.text: Program Introduction While the business world is becoming increasingly borderless, those who will eventually stand out are expected to contribute to a sustainable business growth on an international scale. For example, these people should have a thorough understanding of business and should be confident in collaborating with people from different cultural backgrounds. Participating in this unique program allows you to learn first -hand about how to understand cultural concepts and develop a sustainable competitive advantage in an increasingly challenging and volatile business environment. Furthermore, you can develop a mindset to take initiatives in leading strategic changes with global implications. Curriculum It consists of four units of study (32 credit points), comprising: 9 core courses; 2 elective courses; 2 project courses (click the picture to enlarge) Study Duration 2 years

duration.text: The International Business at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 305 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6944 USD/per year ￥ 50000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of highest education 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here.

requirements.text: 1. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 45 2.Bachelor's degree or equivalent or above. 3.Above 550(paper based) and 80(computer based) in TOFEL or 6.5 in IELTS 4.Be in good health and foreigners
